the use of a BH-CT scan in order to improve the PET-CT co- registration of lung lesions.
the development of new methods to improve the accuracy of PET imaging of lung cancer.
the development of novel PET imaging methods and the evaluation of these methods using clinical data.

the BH-CT acquisition is a feasible, low-dose alternative to the clinical RG-PET protocol.
